scripts.install:all: cd launcher && npm install && cd ../prototypes/mta && npm install && cd ../mta-agentic-migration && npm install
scripts.build:mta-agentic-migration: cd prototypes/mta-agentic-migration && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:launcher && npm run build:mta && npm run build:mta-agentic-migration && npm run assemble
scripts.assemble: rm -rf dist && cp -R launcher/dist dist && mkdir -p dist/mta && cp -R prototypes/mta/dist/* dist/mta/ && mkdir -p dist/mta-agentic-migration && cp -R prototypes/mta-agentic-migration/client/dist/* dist/mta-agentic-migration/
